private-deductibility-general.query: What are the corporate income tax rules for expenses incurred wholly and exclusively for business, and is a private expense deductible?
private-deductibility-general.subject: corporate tax deductibility of private business expenses
private-deductibility-general.passage: Business expenses are deductible only when incurred wholly and exclusively in producing income. The corporate income tax treatment of a private expense is that it is not tax deductible because it does not serve a business purpose.

foreign-dividend-conditional-rule.query: Can a Singapore company qualify for exemption on a foreign-sourced dividend from an overseas subsidiary?
foreign-dividend-conditional-rule.subject: corporate income tax treatment of a foreign dividend
foreign-dividend-conditional-rule.passage: For corporate income tax, specified foreign-sourced income received in Singapore, including a foreign dividend from an overseas subsidiary, may qualify for exemption if the statutory conditions are met.

company-residency-natural.query: How does Singapore determine whether a company is tax resident?
company-residency-natural.subject: how Singapore determines company tax residence
company-residency-natural.passage: For a company, tax residence for a year of assessment is determined by where control and management of the business is exercised in that year.

wht-royalty-hyphenated-query.query: What are the general Singapore withholding-tax rules when a company pays royalties to a non-resident company?
wht-royalty-hyphenated-query.subject: general Singapore withholding-tax rules for company royalty payments to a non-resident company
wht-royalty-hyphenated-query.passage: Royalty withholding tax may apply when a Singapore company pays royalties to a non-resident company. The payer must withhold tax on that royalty payment under the applicable rules.

gst-input-tax-natural.query: What are the general Singapore GST rules for claiming input tax on business purchases by a GST-registered company?
gst-input-tax-natural.subject: general GST input-tax recovery rules for business purchases by a GST-registered company
gst-input-tax-natural.passage: A GST-registered business may recover input tax paid on purchases used to make taxable supplies when the prescribed conditions are met.
